cards.title: Old Guard
cards.text: Tank. A greatsword held in both hands, and forty years of knowing where to put it.
cards.why: Trait: Old Soldier. Allies standing near him take 10% less damage. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Greatsword (attack)
items.text: Old Guard: Greatsword (attack). A slow, wide two-handed cut in front.

items.label: Great Sweep
items.text: Old Guard: Great Sweep. Draws the greatsword back, then sweeps it round in one huge arc in front of him. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Rally
items.text: Old Guard: Rally. An old soldier's shout: allies near him shake off stuns and staggers and stand firm. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Pommel Strike
items.text: Old Guard: Pommel Strike. A quick blow with the pommel that breaks off whatever an enemy was winding up. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Dame
cards.text: Tank. Kite shield, leaf sword, perfect manners. Answers every blow.
cards.why: Trait: Grace. Every third blow she lands is a critical hit. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Leaf sword (attack)
items.text: Dame: Leaf sword (attack). A quick, neat cut.

items.label: Riposte
items.text: Dame: Riposte. Raises the shield; every blow it stops from the front is answered with a thrust. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Challenge
items.text: Dame: Challenge. Calls out the strongest enemy near: it has to fight her, and she hits it harder. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Disarm
items.text: Dame: Disarm. A flick of the blade at an enemy's weapon hand: its blows land far softer for a while. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Griffon
cards.text: Tank. Winged helm, warhammer, shield. Drops out of the sky onto whoever is bothering his friends.
cards.why: Trait: Skyborn. Can't be rooted or entangled. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Warhammer (attack)
items.text: Griffon: Warhammer (attack). A heavy hammer blow.

items.label: Swoop
items.text: Griffon: Swoop. Spreads his wings and flies to the ally in the most trouble, landing beside them with a slam that throws their attackers off. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Stormhammer
items.text: Griffon: Stormhammer. Hurls the hammer down a line; it spins out and comes back to his hand, hitting everything both ways. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Wing Guard
items.text: Griffon: Wing Guard. Raises the shield with his wings spread: shots that reach him from the front are caught and thrown back. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Bulwark
cards.text: Tank. A winged spear and a big shield. Nothing gets past the end of the spear.
cards.why: Trait: Phalanx. Takes 10% less damage for each ally close by, up to 30%. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Winged spear (attack)
items.text: Bulwark: Winged spear (attack). A long thrust that reaches past the front line.

items.label: Brace
items.text: Bulwark: Brace. Sets the spear and waits: whatever comes into its reach is struck hard and stopped dead. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Shield Wall
items.text: Bulwark: Shield Wall. Plants the shield: he can't be moved, and allies close to him take less damage. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Impale
items.text: Bulwark: Impale. A heavy thrust that pins one enemy to the spot. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Bearskin
cards.text: Fighter. A studded club and a bear on his back. Hits like the bear did.
cards.why: Trait: Thick Hide. Statuses build half as fast on him. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Studded club (attack)
items.text: Bearskin: Studded club (attack). A heavy club blow.

items.label: Maul
items.text: Bearskin: Maul. Raises the club high and brings it straight down on one enemy. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Hibernate
items.text: Bearskin: Hibernate. Curls up under the pelt: takes far less damage and heals while he lies there. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Bear Roar
items.text: Bearskin: Bear Roar. A roar that takes the fight out of the enemies round him. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Warhelm
cards.text: Fighter. A beard, a helm, a hammer the size of a sheep. Knocks things a long way.
cards.why: Trait: Iron Will. Below 30% health he can't be stunned or staggered and hits 25% harder. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Warhammer (attack)
items.text: Warhelm: Warhammer (attack). A huge hammer blow that knocks enemies back.

items.label: Thunder Blow
items.text: Warhelm: Thunder Blow. Brings the hammer down so hard that everything in front of him is thrown back. Shown at tier III.

items.label: War Horn
items.text: Warhelm: War Horn. Blows the horn: allies near him hit harder for a while. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Skull Splitter
items.text: Warhelm: Skull Splitter. Two blows: one up under the chin, then one straight down. The second hits double on a staggered foe. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Bandit
cards.text: Skirmisher. A cutlass, a red bandanna and very quick hands. Fights dirty and comes home richer.
cards.why: Trait: Light Fingers. Enemies she finishes drop half again as much gold. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Cutlass (attack)
items.text: Bandit: Cutlass (attack). Quick cutlass slashes.

items.label: Smoke Bomb
items.text: Bandit: Smoke Bomb. Throws a smoke bomb into the enemies: inside the cloud they can't see who to hit. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Pickpocket
items.text: Bandit: Pickpocket. Darts past an enemy and cuts its purse: coins spill out. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Low Blow
items.text: Bandit: Low Blow. A kick where it hurts: the enemy goes down for a moment. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Shade
cards.text: Skirmisher. Two mirrored daggers and a cape the colour of a shadow. Hard to find, harder to hit.
cards.why: Trait: Fade. After 3s without being hit, the next blow meant for her finds only shadow. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Twin daggers (attack)
items.text: Shade: Twin daggers (attack). Quick stabs with either hand.

items.label: Shadow Walk
items.text: Shade: Shadow Walk. Becomes a shadow and runs straight through the enemies, cutting each one she passes. Nothing can touch her meanwhile. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Blackout
items.text: Shade: Blackout. Snuffs out the light round her: enemies in the dark hit softer and she hits them harder. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Death Mark
items.text: Shade: Death Mark. Marks an enemy. After 3s the mark bursts for part of everything it took meanwhile. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Haymaker
cards.text: Fighter. A pitchfork, a straw hat, and the shoulders of a man who throws hay all day.
cards.why: Trait: Hard Work. Each enemy he finishes heals him 5%. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Pitchfork (attack)
items.text: Haymaker: Pitchfork (attack). A long jab with the fork.

items.label: Toss
items.text: Haymaker: Toss. Forks the nearest enemy and throws it over his shoulder. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Pitch Hay
items.text: Haymaker: Pitch Hay. Flings a forkful of hay over the enemies in front: they are slowed, and the dry hay catches fire easily. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Fork Charge
items.text: Haymaker: Fork Charge. Runs with the fork lowered, skewering the first enemy and carrying it along. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Digger
cards.text: Fighter. A long-handled spade. Digs, flings, bats, and finds coins in the floor.
cards.why: Trait: Prospector. Now and then digs a coin out of the floor while he fights. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Spade (attack)
items.text: Digger: Spade (attack). A swing with the flat of the spade.

items.label: Dirt Fling
items.text: Digger: Dirt Fling. Digs up a spadeful of dirt and flings it in the enemies' faces. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Burrow
items.text: Digger: Burrow. Dives into the ground and tunnels to a far enemy, bursting up under it. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Spade Bat
items.text: Digger: Spade Bat. A full swing with the flat of the spade that bats an enemy across the room. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Grandpa Sickle
cards.text: Support. A sickle, a sheaf of wheat and a bag of bread. Feeds the party and trims the enemy.
cards.why: Trait: Seen It All. Allies near him shake off stagger twice as fast. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Sickle (attack)
items.text: Grandpa Sickle: Sickle (attack). A short hooked cut.

items.label: Bread Toss
items.text: Grandpa Sickle: Bread Toss. Lobs a loaf of fresh bread to a hurt ally; it heals them where it lands. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Harvest
items.text: Grandpa Sickle: Harvest. A low sweep round his feet that cuts at the legs of everything close. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Old Tales
items.text: Grandpa Sickle: Old Tales. Tells the party one of his stories. Somehow it helps. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Alchemist
cards.text: Caster. Wild white hair, brass goggles, a strap of flasks. Every throw is a different brew.
cards.why: Trait: Catalyst. The statuses she causes build 30% faster. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Unstable flask (attack)
items.text: Alchemist: Unstable flask (attack). A lobbed flask that splashes where it lands; each one is a different brew: fire, frost or acid.

items.label: Acid Flask
items.text: Alchemist: Acid Flask. A flask of acid that shatters into a hissing pool. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Elixir
items.text: Alchemist: Elixir. Throws a bright potion to an ally: it heals and quickens them. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Bang Flask
items.text: Alchemist: Bang Flask. A sputtering flask that rolls to a stop, then blows up with a huge shove. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Shaman
cards.text: Support. A winged totem on his back and a feather spirit-stick. Calls on the ancestors and the rain.
cards.why: Trait: Ancestral Spirits. When an ally goes down, the spirits heal everyone else 10%. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Spirit bolt (attack)
items.text: Shaman: Spirit bolt (attack). A teal spirit; a little of what it deals heals the most hurt ally.

items.label: Healing Totem
items.text: Shaman: Healing Totem. Plants a carved totem that heals the allies near it. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Spirit Link
items.text: Shaman: Spirit Link. Binds allies together with spirit threads: a blow on one is shared out among them all. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Rain Dance
items.text: Shaman: Rain Dance. Calls a rain cloud over the enemies: it soaks them and puts fires out. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Witch
cards.text: Caster. A crooked violet hat and a broom. Turns problems into frogs.
cards.why: Trait: Crone. Cursed enemies take 25% more from her. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Hex bolt (attack)
items.text: Witch: Hex bolt (attack). A wobbling green spark that curves after its target.

items.label: Hex
items.text: Witch: Hex. Turns an enemy into a frog: it can't attack, hops slowly and takes more damage. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Cursed Brew
items.text: Witch: Cursed Brew. Sets down a bubbling cauldron whose fumes curse whatever breathes them. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Broom Ride
items.text: Witch: Broom Ride. Hops on the broom and flies out of trouble. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Warlock
cards.text: Caster. Horns, a gold sceptre and a demon-eye orb. Pays for power in his own blood.
cards.why: Trait: Infernal. Can't be set on fire. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Pact bolt (attack)
items.text: Warlock: Pact bolt (attack). A magenta bolt; a third of what it deals heals him.

items.label: Eldritch Beam
items.text: Warlock: Eldritch Beam. Holds a beam on an enemy that grows hotter the longer it holds. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Summon Imp
items.text: Warlock: Summon Imp. Tears open the floor and an imp climbs out to throw fire for him. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Dark Bargain
items.text: Warlock: Dark Bargain. Pays in his own blood: his other abilities are ready again at once. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Cultist
cards.text: Caster. A tall black hood, a curved dagger and a burning black candle. Pays in blood for the party's strength.
cards.why: Trait: Black Candle. Enemies close to him are slowly cursed. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Shadow bolt (attack)
items.text: Cultist: Shadow bolt (attack). A bolt of violet shadow from the candle.

items.label: Blood Pact
items.text: Cultist: Blood Pact. Cuts his palm: gives up some of his health so the allies near him hit harder. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Ritual Circle
items.text: Cultist: Ritual Circle. Draws a burning circle under the enemies that curses whatever stands in it. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Soul Candle
items.text: Cultist: Soul Candle. The black candle flares: every enemy that dies near him for a while bursts into soul fire. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Monk
cards.text: Fighter. Saffron robe, prayer beads, bare fists. Very calm. Very fast.
cards.why: Trait: Deflect. Swats aside 40% of the shots that reach him from the front. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Fists (attack)
items.text: Monk: Fists (attack). Quick jabs with either fist.

items.label: Flurry
items.text: Monk: Flurry. A blur of punches into one enemy; each one heals him a little. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Palm Strike
items.text: Monk: Palm Strike. An open palm that drives the force right through: the enemy and everything behind it in a line are thrown back. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Inner Peace
items.text: Monk: Inner Peace. Sits and breathes: his statuses fall away and he heals. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Seer
cards.text: Support. Blindfolded, silver-haired, a glowing crystal in her hand. Sees what's coming and tells the party.
cards.why: Trait: Third Eye. Can't be blinded, and sees 15% of blows coming in time to step aside. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Glimmer (attack)
items.text: Seer: Glimmer (attack). A crystal mote that glances off its target onto a second enemy.

items.label: Foresight
items.text: Seer: Foresight. Marks the strongest enemy in sight: the whole party hits it harder. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Premonition
items.text: Seer: Premonition. Sees a blow coming: the ally in the most danger slips out of its way. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Starfall
items.text: Seer: Starfall. Calls stars down out of nowhere onto the enemies round a spot. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Chef
cards.text: Support. A toque, a moustache, a frying pan and a wooden spoon. Feeds friends and flings pies at everyone.
cards.why: Trait: Well Fed. Allies near him heal 0.5% of their health a second. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Frying pan (attack)
items.text: Chef: Frying pan (attack). A clanging whack with the pan.

items.label: Hot Meal
items.text: Chef: Hot Meal. Sets a hot plate down by a hurt ally; whoever eats it is healed. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Grease Fire
items.text: Chef: Grease Fire. Flips the pan: hot grease splashes over the floor in front, slick and slow. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Food Fight
items.text: Chef: Food Fight. Flings custard pies at several enemies. They splat. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Beekeeper
cards.text: Support. A veiled hat, a copper smoker, and a great many friends who sting.
cards.why: Trait: Bee Friends. A few bees always buzz round him and sting enemies that come close. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Bee (attack)
items.text: Beekeeper: Bee (attack). Sends a bee buzzing after the target.

items.label: Swarm
items.text: Beekeeper: Swarm. Opens the hive: bees pour out and chase the nearest enemies, stinging and slowing. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Honey Pot
items.text: Beekeeper: Honey Pot. Throws a pot of honey: enemies get stuck in it, friends get a sweet treat. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Royal Jelly
items.text: Beekeeper: Royal Jelly. Feeds an ally royal jelly: it attacks much faster for a while. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Quartermaster
cards.text: Support. A pack bigger than he is. Keeps the party fed, armed and stocked, and throws the pots.
cards.why: Trait: Well Stocked. Once a minute, a friend near him who has no health potion gets one. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Pot toss (attack)
items.text: Quartermaster: Pot toss (attack). Throws a pot or a pan out of the pack.

items.label: Resupply
items.text: Quartermaster: Resupply. Tosses a supply bundle to the ally who needs it most. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Oil the Blades
items.text: Quartermaster: Oil the Blades. Hands round lamp oil for the weapons: the allies near him set things alight with every blow. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Flare
items.text: Quartermaster: Flare. Fires a red flare onto the enemies: whatever stands in its light is easy to hit. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Crossbowman
cards.text: Shooter. A heavy crossbow, a kettle hat and a tall shield on his back. Slow to load, hard to stop.
cards.why: Trait: Armour Piercing. His bolts hit elites, majors and bosses 25% harder. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Heavy bolt (attack)
items.text: Crossbowman: Heavy bolt (attack). A heavy crossbow bolt that goes through the first enemy it hits.

items.label: Pavise
items.text: Crossbowman: Pavise. Plants the tall shield in front of him and shoots from behind it. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Pinning Bolt
items.text: Crossbowman: Pinning Bolt. A barbed bolt that nails an enemy to the floor. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Crank Up
items.text: Crossbowman: Crank Up. Cranks the crossbow hard and loads blasting bolts. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Falconer
cards.text: Shooter. A rust beret, a leather gauntlet and a slate-grey falcon. The falcon does the hunting.
cards.why: Trait: Bird's Eye. Sees and throws 25% further than anyone else. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Throwing knife (attack)
items.text: Falconer: Throwing knife (attack). A thrown hunting knife.

items.label: Loose the Falcon
items.text: Falconer: Loose the Falcon. Sends the falcon at the furthest enemy: it marks it and pecks at it. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Keen Eye
items.text: Falconer: Keen Eye. Takes careful aim for a while: every throw goes further and some land just right. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Call the Flock
items.text: Falconer: Call the Flock. Whistles up a flock of small birds that sweeps through a line of enemies, pecking. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Grenadier
cards.text: Shooter. A tall mitre cap, a handlebar moustache and a lit bomb, always. Solves problems loudly.
cards.why: Trait: Demolition. His blasts throw enemies twice as far. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Bomb (attack)
items.text: Grenadier: Bomb (attack). Lobs a small bomb that bursts where it lands.

items.label: Big Bomb
items.text: Grenadier: Big Bomb. Lobs a huge bomb with a long fuse. Everyone sees it coming. It doesn't help. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Sticky Bomb
items.text: Grenadier: Sticky Bomb. Sticks a bomb to an enemy; it goes off a moment later. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Blast Off
items.text: Grenadier: Blast Off. Drops a bomb at his own feet and rides the blast out of trouble. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Harpooner
cards.text: Shooter. A yellow sou'wester, a puffy grey moustache, a barbed harpoon on a rope.
cards.why: Trait: Old Salt. Can't be soaked, and hits wet enemies 20% harder. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Harpoon (attack)
items.text: Harpooner: Harpoon (attack). A thrown barbed harpoon, pulled back on its rope.

items.label: Reel In
items.text: Harpooner: Reel In. Harpoons a far enemy and hauls on the rope: a small one is dragged to him, a big one drags him to it. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Rogue Wave
items.text: Harpooner: Rogue Wave. Calls up a wave of sea water that crashes over the enemies in front. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Drop Anchor
items.text: Harpooner: Drop Anchor. Swings a ship's anchor round on its chain and drops it on the enemies. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Javelin Huntress
cards.text: Shooter. A coral headband, a ponytail, a bundle of javelins. Runs prey down.
cards.why: Trait: Finisher. Hits enemies below half health 25% harder. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Javelin (attack)
items.text: Javelin Huntress: Javelin (attack). A hard-thrown javelin that knocks its target back.

items.label: Running Throw
items.text: Javelin Huntress: Running Throw. Sprints round her target and puts a javelin in its back. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Bound
items.text: Javelin Huntress: Bound. Leaps back out of reach and throws a javelin at the top of the leap. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Prey
items.text: Javelin Huntress: Prey. Picks out the weakest enemy and hunts it down. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Marksman
cards.text: Shooter. A cavalier hat with a cream plume, a grey moustache, a very long musket. One shot, well placed.
cards.why: Trait: Deadeye. His first hit on an enemy that hasn't been hurt yet is a critical hit. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Musket (attack)
items.text: Marksman: Musket (attack). One long, hard shot.

items.label: Aimed Shot
items.text: Marksman: Aimed Shot. Stands stock still, aims, and fires a shot that goes clean through. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Bayonet
items.text: Marksman: Bayonet. Fixes the bayonet and stabs whatever got too close, shoving it away. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Ricochet
items.text: Marksman: Ricochet. A shot aimed to glance off one enemy onto the next. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Ninja
cards.text: Shooter. Charcoal hood, crimson scarf, a shuriken in each hand. Hard to pin down.
cards.why: Trait: Assassin. Her shuriken hit 50% harder from behind. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Shuriken (attack)
items.text: Ninja: Shuriken (attack). Quick shuriken from either hand.

items.label: Shuriken Fan
items.text: Ninja: Shuriken Fan. Throws a fan of shuriken, then vanishes in smoke and appears a little way off. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Substitution
items.text: Ninja: Substitution. When a big blow lands, it was a log all along: she is somewhere else. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Caltrops
items.text: Ninja: Caltrops. Scatters iron caltrops round her feet. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Pirate
cards.text: Skirmisher. Tricorn, cutlass, flintlock. Fights dirty, drinks worse, calls in the ship's guns.
cards.why: Trait: Dirty Fighting. Hits staggered, stunned, slowed or rooted enemies 30% harder. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Cutlass (attack)
items.text: Pirate: Cutlass (attack). Fast cutlass slashes.

items.label: Point Blank
items.text: Pirate: Point Blank. Jams the flintlock against an enemy and fires. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Grog
items.text: Pirate: Grog. A long swig of grog. Things hurt less for a while. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Broadside
items.text: Pirate: Broadside. Whistles to the ship: cannonballs come down round a spot. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Slinger
cards.text: Shooter. A shepherd in a ram's fleece with a sling and a crook. Stones, and the flock behind him.
cards.why: Trait: Watchful. Allies near him shake off stuns and sleep 40% faster. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Sling (attack)
items.text: Slinger: Sling (attack). A whirl and a stone.

items.label: Stunning Stone
items.text: Slinger: Stunning Stone. Whirls the sling hard and lets fly a stone at the head. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Ram
items.text: Slinger: Ram. Whistles, and a big ram charges through a line of enemies. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Gravel
items.text: Slinger: Gravel. Slings a handful of gravel in a wide spray. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Trapper
cards.text: Shooter. A fur cap with the flaps down, a short rifle and a jaw trap. Catches things.
cards.why: Trait: Trapper's Eye. Enemies that are held, rooted or tangled take 30% more from him. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Short rifle (attack)
items.text: Trapper: Short rifle (attack). A rifle shot.

items.label: Jaw Trap
items.text: Trapper: Jaw Trap. Sets a jaw trap where the enemies are coming; the first to step in is caught. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Weighted Net
items.text: Trapper: Weighted Net. Throws a weighted net over a group of enemies. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Tripwire
items.text: Trapper: Tripwire. Strings a wire across the enemies' way: whatever runs into it goes down. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Gladiator
cards.text: Fighter. A crested bronze helm, a gladius and a little round shield. Plays to the crowd.
cards.why: Trait: Arena. Hits 5% harder for each enemy near him, up to 25%. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Gladius (attack)
items.text: Gladiator: Gladius (attack). A short, quick stab.

items.label: Net Throw
items.text: Gladiator: Net Throw. Casts a net over one enemy: it is held and he stabs it harder. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Showboat
items.text: Gladiator: Showboat. Raises the gladius to the crowd: enemies near turn on him and he braces. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Shield Rush
items.text: Gladiator: Shield Rush. Rushes in behind the round shield and stabs. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Jester
cards.text: Skirmisher. A three-pointed cap with bells and a marotte on a stick. Makes enemies look foolish, then fight.
cards.why: Trait: Pratfall. The first time each room a blow would down him, he trips out of its way. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Marotte (attack)
items.text: Jester: Marotte (attack). A bonk with the jester's stick.

items.label: Mock
items.text: Jester: Mock. Pulls a face and blows a raspberry: enemies near can't help chasing him. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Befuddle
items.text: Jester: Befuddle. Tells an enemy a joke so bad it turns on its own friends for a moment. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Juggling Act
items.text: Jester: Juggling Act. Throws his juggling balls: they bounce from enemy to enemy. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Samurai
cards.text: Fighter. An indigo kabuto with gold horns and a long katana. Waits, then cuts.
cards.why: Trait: Bushido. Below 35% health he cuts 40% faster. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Katana (attack)
items.text: Samurai: Katana (attack). A clean, wide cut.

items.label: Iaido
items.text: Samurai: Iaido. Sheathes the blade, then flashes straight through a line of enemies, cutting every one. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Focus
items.text: Samurai: Focus. Breathes in and settles: his next cut lands with everything. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Crescent Cut
items.text: Samurai: Crescent Cut. A cut so fast it flies off the blade as a crescent through the enemies. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Valkyrie
cards.text: Fighter. A winged helm, long plaits and a big spear. Carries the fallen back into the fight.
cards.why: Trait: Chooser of the Slain. Revives the fallen twice as fast, at 30% health. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Spear (attack)
items.text: Valkyrie: Spear (attack). A long spear thrust.

items.label: Valkyrie's Call
items.text: Valkyrie: Valkyrie's Call. Calls a fallen ally back to their feet at once. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Spear of the Sky
items.text: Valkyrie: Spear of the Sky. Hurls the spear down a line; it flies back to her hand. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Sky Dive
items.text: Valkyrie: Sky Dive. Leaps high on her wings and dives spear-first onto an enemy. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Engineer
cards.text: Fighter. An orange work suit, a welding mask raised and a very big wrench. Builds a turret and keeps it.
cards.why: Trait: Handy. Things he builds or calls take 30% less damage. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Wrench (attack)
items.text: Engineer: Wrench (attack). A clanging swing of the wrench.

items.label: Deploy Turret
items.text: Engineer: Deploy Turret. Sets down a turret that swivels and shoots the nearest enemy. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Tinker
items.text: Engineer: Tinker. A few smart knocks with the wrench: his turrets are patched up, and so is a friend. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Shock Mine
items.text: Engineer: Shock Mine. Tosses out a mine that goes off with a crackle when an enemy comes near. Shown at tier III.

cards.title: Werewolf
cards.text: Fighter. A woodsman with a hatchet and a torn red shirt. Then, when it matters, a great grey wolf.
cards.why: Trait: Moonblood. Heals 1% of his health a second while fighting. Tick what reads well; anything unticked or commented on gets reworked.

items.label: Hatchet (attack)
items.text: Werewolf: Hatchet (attack). A woodsman's chop. As a wolf: quick raking claws with either paw.

items.label: Turn
items.text: Werewolf: Turn. Lets the wolf out: faster, and the claws come twice as fast as the hatchet. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Frenzy
items.text: Werewolf: Frenzy. Each blow in a row comes faster than the last. Shown at tier III.

items.label: Pounce
items.text: Werewolf: Pounce. Leaps onto a far enemy and pins it to the floor. Shown at tier III.
